lina (docs): Heads-up: opened PR to tighten up the model card wording for embedding sharding and to replace the example with an SDK v3 idiom. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/859
lina (docs): Changes: clarify "shard allocation" math, add compatibility note about CPU-quantized fallbacks, include mini troubleshooting with Console log query, and swap snippet to ShardConfig usage.
omar (ml): Nice. Can you include a short benchmark table for the common 1k/10k corpus cases so customers know perf tradeoffs? I can paste numbers if you want.
lina (docs): Yes please — would prefer a tiny 3-row table (1k/5k/10k) with median latency + tokens/sec. Keep it one line per row.
pavan (runtime): Two technical notes: 1) ordering is deterministic per current implementation, but when a request is split across async shards the final buffer merge respects original indices — we should warn about async callbacks reordering if devs mutate in-place. 2) quantized CPU fallbacks use block-padding that can slightly change similarity ranking in rare cases.
tess (sdk): I'll propose the new snippet to match SDK v3 patterns. Suggest example and an inline assertion to check indexing mapping back to inputs.

proposed snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ShardConfig
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
texts = ["alpha", "beta", "gamma"]
shard_cfg = ShardConfig(size=2, deterministic=True)
embs = client.embeddings.create(model="nebula-embed-1", inputs=texts, shard_config=shard_cfg)
# emb list aligns with inputs by index
assert len(embs) == len(texts)
```

lina (docs): Added a short line linking to sharding policy and formula: shards = ceil(total_tokens / shard_size_tokens). Also swapped examples in nebula.md to this snippet.
jules (pm): Can we add a product note to reduce confusion between "shard_size" and "token_window"? Customers ask about both often. Maybe a one-line cross-ref would do.
lina (docs): Done — added cross-ref to tokenization + shard sizing doc. Kept it compact.
omar (ml): I ran the A/B on 8k pairs vs main using the quant fallback path. Delta AUC = 0.0011 (within noise). I'll attach the mini table: 1k: 120ms / 8.5k tps; 5k: 420ms / 10.2k tps; 10k: 810ms / 12.4k tps.
pavan (runtime): Can you also include the sample log query for SRE: `service:inference AND model:nebula-embed-1 AND response.variant:quantized` (this helps tracing fallback events).
lina (docs): Added that exact query in troubleshooting. Also fixed three link targets that were broken by previous refactor; link-bot confirmed.
link-bot: linkcheck: 3 links updated, 0 remaining failures.
tess (sdk): One more SDK nit: in our README we still show the old positional shard_size param. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to update the README to point at the new model card snippet once this merges.
jules (pm): Rollout plan: merge docs PR today, follow with SDK README PR in 24h, and schedule a short note for Dedicated customers about variant pinning options. I'll draft that.
lina (docs): Thanks! @pavan @tess can you drop LGTM once wording looks right? I want to merge after CI completes.
pavan (runtime): LGTM after we keep the CPU fallback caveat sentence.
tess (sdk): LGTM.
lina (docs): Merging after CI. Thanks all :rocket:
